partialReadProgress.scope: Completed object-addressed API observations and per-file comparisons; account attribution/verification frozen per head until purge/expiry; API-host partition isolates sources; token rotation retains progress
partialReadProgress.authority: Observations only; live head and review reads, completeness checks, provenance and preservation predicates remain mandatory
partialReadProgress.retention: Seven days; independent 512-progress-directory count and aggregate 256 MiB serialized-file budget at periodic sweep; completed publication removes head progress; repository rename skips payloads
partialReadProgress.ownership: Canonical effective UID and symlink checks on store, progress directory and record; atomic 0600 temporary file and rename; cancelled/failed reads never publish
partialReadProgress.recovery: Semantic blob/tree/pagination rejection aborts sibling publications and purges head progress; canonical-owner manual purge refreshes account snapshots; transport timeouts retain completed progress
